subhed: As midterm elections approach, the Trump administration is favoring economic pressure over military involvement, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announcing Monday some 60 new Iranian entities, individuals and ships have been added to the sanctions list. title: Europeans condemn Russia's campaign of terror in Ukraine
subhed: Meeting with Volodymyr Zelensky on Monday, August 24, for a Coalition of the Willing conference, European leaders reiterated their military and financial support for Kyiv and denounced Russia's intensifying strikes on civilian infrastructure.

title: 'The hens suffocated': Fewer, smaller eggs are the double effect of France's scorching summer
subhed: Episodes of extreme heat have exposed stark differences in how well poultry farms are equipped to adapt, with up to 2% of the country's laying hens dying during the June heatwave alone. Beyond excess mortality, the heat also reduces egg production and results in smaller eggs, causing further losses for farmers.

title: 'Citizens no longer trusted us': Belgium's attempt to revive democracy
subhed: 'Room for Hope' (1/6). High voter abstention, unfulfilled political promises and the growing influence of authoritarian movements have weakened democracies. In response to this crisis, Belgian writer David Van Reybrouck is behind numerous initiatives that hope to reinvigorate democratic practice.

title: Unprecedented crisis grips US colleges, squeezed by soaring costs and Trump-fuelled distrust
subhed: Around 15 higher education institutions closed in 2025 due to debt, and about 40 closed in 2024. In addition to cuts in government funding, academia faced a decline in enrollment as many young people questioned the value of the skills taught.

title: Want peace and quiet in France? These are the best places to buy property
